final_message:
The issue was in the `wrap` function's boundary logic. The original code used `>= width` which caused it to break when a word would exactly fill the width, instead of only breaking when it would exceed the width. I rewrote the logic to:

1. Always add the first word
2. For subsequent words, check if adding them would exceed the width before deciding to wrap

The key change was from `len(cur) + extra >= width` (which breaks at exact width) to `len(cur) + extra_len > width` (which only breaks when exceeding width).
